    The 2026 NFL Draft takes place from Thursday, April 23, through Saturday, April 25, 2026, in Pittsburgh, PA. The event will be held near Acrisure Stadium and Point State Park, with coverage on NFL Network, ABC, and ESPN. 
    2026 NFL Draft Schedule: 
    • Round 1: Thursday, April 23 at 8 p.m. ET
    • Rounds 2-3: Friday, April 24 at 7 p.m. ET
    • Rounds 4-7: Saturday, April 25 at Noon ET 
    This is the 91st edition of the NFL Draft and the first time Pittsburgh is hosting the event since 1948. The time allowed for first-round selections has been shortened to eight minutes

    What happens to undrafted free agents?
    Once a player becomes an undrafted free agent, they can negotiate with any team that has a roster spot available and is interested. Undrafted players thus have a lot of freedom to choose where they go to an extent, but the chances of making a roster are also much slimmer.Jun 27, 2024
